title: Join us on Friday, April 24th, 2026 for our next session of the Public Webinar Series!
bodyHtml:
UniProt and Common Fund Data Ecosystem Partnership for AI-Driven Biomedical Discovery
? Friday, April 24, 2026
⏰ 1:00–2:00 PM ET

In this session, UniProt will present recent work and collaborations advancing AI-driven biomedical discovery.

Topics will include:
? A knowledge graph for data integration and knowledge discovery
? An introduction to the Protein Knowledge Network (ProKN) and key use cases
? Integration of ProKN and CFDE within the NSF Proto-OKN initiative

Hear from speakers:
Cathy Wu, Professor, University of Delaware
Chuming Chen, Professor, University of Delaware
Manju Anandakrishnan, Data Scientist, University of Delaware
Karen Ross, Professor, Georgetown University

? Register here: https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_x0bGLLt4TbqFGlxlMM-T2A
